{'text': '歡迎來到 Indie App Spotlight。呢個係 9to5Mac 每週推出嘅系列，專門介紹獨立應用程式界嘅最新 apps。如果你係開發者，希望自己嘅 app 可以獲介紹，請聯絡我哋。', 'source': 'Welcome to Indie App Spotlight. This is a 9to5Mac weekly series that features the latest apps in the indie app space. If you’re a developer and want your app featured, reach out to us.'}

{'text': '如果你成日唔記得啲你想之後再睇嘅嘢，Laytr 可能係一個幾好嘅解決方案。大家都會將嘢儲到唔同地方，無論係瀏覽器書籤、應用程式內置嘅收藏功能、影低個螢幕希望之後搵得返，又或者淨係擺住個分頁唔關，希望日後再搵返。Laytr 就係想做一個一站式嘅方案，幫你管理所有數碼收藏。', 'source': 'If you find yourself constantly forgetting things you want to come back to later, Laytr might be a good solution. We all store things in different places, whether it’s bookmarks in our browsers, built-in favorites inside apps, screenshots you take hoping to find later, or just leaving a tab open for later. Laytr aims to be a one-stop shop for all your digital collections.'}

{'text': '重點功能', 'source': 'Key features'}

{'text': 'Laytr 提供一個極之井然有序嘅介面，等你可以清楚掌握所有嘢。佢支援 iOS 原生分享選單，所以你一搵到想儲存嘅內容，只要撳分享再揀 Laytr 就可以。之後，你可以為內容設定分類，以及揀定幾時想再收到提醒。', 'source': 'Laytr provides an exceptionally organized interface so you can see everything. It supports the iOS native Share menu, so whenever you find something you want to save, just tap share and select Laytr. From there, you can set categories for the content, as well as pick when you want to be reminded again.'}

{'text': '喺 app 裡面，主要分為三個核心分頁。第一個係 Now（即刻），用嚟突顯你需要即時處理嘅事項。仲有 Timeline（時間線），可以讓你向前翻睇，按你設定嘅提醒日期排列內容；以及 Library（資料庫），可以睇到你曾經儲存嘅所有嘢，無論係按分類或者集中顯示都得。除咗呢啲，你亦可以用搜尋功能。', 'source': 'Inside the app, there are three core tabs. The first one is Now, which is designed to highlight what you need to deal with right away. There’s also Timeline, which lets you go forward and see your content sorted by the reminder dates you set; and Library, where you can see everything you’ve ever saved, either sorted by category or all in one view. On top of that, you can also use search.'}

{'text': '一個與別不同嘅特色係，佢冇同步功能，就算用 iCloud 都唔會，亦唔需要註冊帳戶。所有資料都儲存在你自己嘅裝置上，喺一個獨立嘅空間運作，你嘅數據永遠唔會上傳到其他人嘅伺服器。', 'source': 'One unique differentiator is that it has no syncing whatsoever, not even with iCloud, and no account registration required. Everything lives on your own device, in its own sandbox, and your data never gets uploaded to anyone else’s servers.'}

{'text': '下載 app', 'source': 'Download the app'}

{'text': 'Laytr 喺 App Store 免費提供畀運行 iOS 17 及以上版本嘅 iPhone 用戶。你可以免費使用呢個 app，但如果想無限使用，就要訂閱 1.99 美元/月或者 14.99 美元/年嘅方案。仲有終身買斷嘅折扣，原價係 39.99 美元，早期採用者可以 24.99 美元買到。', 'source': 'Laytr is available for free on the App Store for iPhone users running iOS 17 and later. You can use the app for free, but for unlimited use, you’ll need to subscribe to a $1.99/month or $14.99/year plan. There’s also a discounted lifetime purchase option that costs $24.99 for early adopters, with a retail price of $39.99.'}

{'text': '搜尋同匯出呢類功能永遠唔會受到付費牆限制，所以就算你之後決定取消訂閱，個 app 仍然可以繼續用。', 'source': 'Features like search and export will never be behind the paywall, so even if you decide to cancel your subscription later, the app will still continue to work.'}
